facts.business: BASF India Limited is a diversified chemical company operating in segments such as Nutrition & Care, Industrial Solutions, Agricultural Solutions, and Coatings, providing innovative and sustainable solutions across industries.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Demerger of Agricultural Solutions business into a separate listed entity, BASF Agricultural Solutions India Limited
Sale of 100% stake in BASF India Coatings Private Limited to Carlyle Group companies

key_risks: Volatility in energy and feedstock markets
Pricing challenges across the chemical industry
facts.related_party_note: Transfer of Coatings business to wholly owned subsidiary BASF India Coatings Private Limited on slump sale basis for Rs 2,119.0 million effective January 1, 2025; subsequent sale of 100% stake in the subsidiary to Carlyle Group companies for Rs 2,301.6 million approved March 30, 2026.
